# Forecast results (auto-generated)

**REAL DATA (frozen dataset).** Generated by `src/forecast/evaluate.py`. Interpretation: `docs/forecast_findings.md`.

- Target: any stockout in the next clock hour (UTC), horizon 6 h; eligible rows only (see `analysis_charter.md`).
- Dataset: 212,467 station-hours, 272 stations, 34 distinct UTC days; features: hour_of_day, day_of_week, avg_availability, min_bikes, stockout_share, stuck_share, avail_lag1, avail_lag2, avail_lag3, avail_change_1h, stockout_lag1.
- Rolling origin: expanding window, first test day after 7 training days, 27 test days, 173,334 predictions per model.

## F7. Placebo check (last test day): features swapped between stations in the same hour

Scores should fall to roughly the reference level; if they stayed high, something other than the station's own state would be driving them.

|---|---|---|
| real features | 0.1456 | 0.6866 |
| features swapped between stations in the same hour | 0.1619 | 0.5388 |
| constant base rate (reference) | 0.1529 | 0.5 |
